= filepath_split

Splits a filepath into directory and filename components.


== Examples

[,bloblang]
----
root.path_sep = this.path.filepath_split()

# In:  {"path":"/foo/bar.txt"}
# Out: {"path_sep":["/foo/","bar.txt"]}

# In:  {"path":"baz.txt"}
# Out: {"path_sep":["","baz.txt"]}
----
